notes.title: STAaRS is Now Free to Play
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that STAaRS (Space Time Anomalies and Reality Security) is now completely free to play.
This change allows more players to join the STAaRS volunteer program and experience the full journey through a reality-bending sci-fi universe.

In STAaRS, you play as a civilian volunteer undergoing recruitment trials for a secretive organization tasked with detecting, analyzing, and responding to space-time anomalies. Your mission is to survive the evaluation process — and prove you’re worthy of joining the elite force that safeguards reality itself.

Core Gameplay Elements:

 *  Investigate strange anomalies in shifting environments
 
 *  Solve logic-based puzzles and uncover hidden patterns
 
 *  Interact with mysterious technology and experimental systems
 
 * Progress through a layered narrative with multiple outcomes


Now is the perfect time to join the investigation.
Download STAaRS today and begin your volunteer evaluation.

notes.title: STAaRS Now Supports 9 Languages! 🌍
notes.content:
🌟 Explore STAaRS in Your Language! 🌟

We're thrilled to announce that STAaRS now supports 9 languages! Previously available only in English, the game has been updated to include:

- 🇫🇷 French
- 🇮🇹 Italian
- 🇩🇪 German
- 🇪🇸 Spanish
- 🇯🇵 Japanese
- 🇰🇷 Korean
- 🇷🇺 Russian
- 🇨🇳 Chinese

This update is designed to make the mysterious and spooky universe of STAaRS more accessible to players worldwide. Whether you're a seasoned investigator or stepping into the simulation for the first time, you can now experience the game in your preferred language.

🛠️ How to Access the New Languages:

You can find the language settings in the Command Center, right next to the Settings button.

Thank you for your continued support and for being a part of the STAaRS community. We can't wait to hear your thoughts on this exciting update!
